{"findings":[{"claim_id":"","quote":"## Important Safety Information

Zelvoran is contraindicated in patients with active, serious infection, including active tuberculosis, and in patients with known serious hypersensitivity to zelvoran or any excipient.

Zelvoran may increase the risk of serious bacterial, fungal and viral infections. Screen for latent tuberculosis before initiating treatment. Elevations in ALT or AST greater than three times the upper limit of normal occurred in 2.1% of Zelvoran-treated patients compared with 0.6% receiving placebo. Serious hypersensitivity reactions, including angioedema, have been reported. The effect of Zelvoran on the risk of malignancy is not known. Avoid live vaccines during treatment.
